newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures close higher on short covering.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures close higher on short covering.

text.p: CME lumber futures remained strong on short covering despite ending under best levels of the day, traders said.
Lumber finished $5.20 to $1.90 per thousand board feet higher with May up most at $401.50 and July up $3.30 at $398.50 per tbf.
Traders said there was a large open interest in the May $400 calls and puts and there appeared to be an effort by local option traders to hold May above $400 into the option expiration Friday.
Adding to short covering support were expectations that interest rates would not rise further any time soon. Futures also showed technical support in the $395 to $396 area, they added.
Strength came despite the recent easier tone to cash lumber and continued slow trade. Wholesalers were cutting prices to move stocks, cash sources said.
